headline: Colonials Seize The Parras as Brutal Attrition Grips Northern Fronts
war_summary: The latest hours brought a fresh territorial breach in the Gutter, where Colonial forces successfully captured The Parras to secure a foothold, marking the newest shift on the map. In contrast, Fisherman's Row has settled into quiet following the earlier fall of Fort Ember. Across the broader battle lines, savage combat endures without immediate base changes, led by ferocious bloodletting in Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle, where combined casualties surpassed thirty-nine hundred and four thousand men over the last two hours. Severe attrition likewise grips Marban Hollow and Nevish Line, both logging heavy two-hour tolls exceeding two thousand casualties, while Stlican Shelf, Linn of Mercy, and the Dead Lands continue to consume substantial troop concentrations. Though hourly casualty rates indicate a slight cooling across several contested sectors, combat density remains exceptionally high along the battered central and northern lines.
